sources.excerpt: 1962X 2-Mode Limited British Overdrive by Keeley Electronics | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Keeley Electronics 1962X 2-Mode Limited British Overdrive LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS BOOSTER OVERDRIVE PREAMP Description Our Keeley 1962X 2-Mode Limited British Overdrive has a wealth of great classic Bluesbreaker tones ready at a moments notice, so what could make it better? Here at Keeley we are not one to sit on a circuit, we constantly dream and imagine what else it could be. So we have come up with something more for the Keeley 1962, Introducing the 1962x. The 1962x is a limited version of our 1962, built in batches when we have the supply, with an additional “KT88” high headroom mode utilizing MOSFET clipping. In the “KT66” mode you will get the same performance and gain range you get in the standard 1962, from mild light breakup all the way to full saturation. In the “KT88” mode, a MOSFET transistor is inserted in the clipping stage to produce a higher output, and a more forceful, focused and meatier sound. The KT88 Mode definitely steps the presence up a notch and acts terrifically to light up the front end of a classic tube amp (maybe even a Bluesbreaker?). Take all of this and place it in a brand new graphic design featuring many classic Bluesbreaker design elements and you end up with an amazing sounding and looking pedal. sources.excerpt: Keeley Electronics 1962x Limited British Overdrive - Pedal of the Day Reviews Demos Buy a Pedalboard Interviews Contact Navigation Menu Menu Keeley Electronics 1962x 2-Mode Limited British Overdrive Posted By Pedal of the Day on Saturday, July 20, 2019 in Keeley Electronics, Overdrive / Distortion | 0 comments --> --> There’s no shortage of amazing effects coming out of the Keeley Electronics camp, as they have been for close to 2 decades now, and we always love it when something new comes through the office. While the past couple of years have seen bigger, more option-filled pedals like the Dark Side , Aria , Super Mod Workstation and more, sometimes you just need a killer overdrive pedal to get you in the right mood, and spark some creativity in your playing. The 1962x is a British overdrive pedal that gives you some classic Bluesbreaker-type tones, crafted using precision components and only the finest workmanship, as you’d of course expect from Robert and his team…. Gain, Treble and Boost make up the simple control section on the 1962x , leading to a wide range of British black-and-gold amplifier sounds throughout the spectrum of these parameters. There’s more to this pedal, however, in the form of a teeny, tiny toggle switch. Select KT88 to enter into a high headroom boost mode, or go with KT66 for your standard overdrive sound. The circuit has been wrapped in Keeley’s own Katana Boost, creating preamp and output tube distortion characteristics with ease. The KT88 mode inserts a MOSFET transistor into the clipping stage, making an already powerful drive tone beefed up, for higher output and a meatier overall sound. The 1962x also plays great with others, especially Klons (or Klones , if you’re like most players), creating fat, rich lead tones for days. Tons of sustain here, coupled with a killer graphic to emulate some vintage amps to add to the nostalgia and force of this absolute beast of a drive. A real amp in a box effect, this one will put a smile on your face the moment you engage it, and for years to come afterwards. Cheers once again to Robert and the entire Keeley Electronics staff, for crushing it AGAIN (we never get tired of saying that) – check out our demo for a taste of what the 1962x is capable of, and then head over to the Keeley site to try and grab one for yourself (if they’re in stock).
